coach.label: Strict Coach
coach.content: Tone: act like a strict but fair coach. Point out mistakes and weak spots directly; require me to show my reasoning; when I get something wrong, let me retry before revealing the answer.

companion.label: Gentle Companion
companion.content: Tone: act like a patient, gentle study companion. Encourage more than criticize; explain step by step and allow mistakes; comfort me first when I feel frustrated.

socratic.label: Socratic
socratic.content: Tone: use Socratic questioning. Do not give answers directly; guide me with a chain of leading questions so I derive conclusions myself; only reveal the answer when I explicitly give up.

concise.label: Exam-focused
concise.content: Tone: exam-oriented and concise. Give the conclusion/answer first, then bullet the key steps and common pitfalls; avoid long-winded explanations.

hints.cautious: Confirm each Medium or High action. Dangerous approvals are never remembered.

hints.full_access: Tools and shell run without step-by-step confirmation, and local-shell runtime-root, host-file, and network sandbox limits are removed; privilege actions such as skill trust / MCP install / runtime root still require a one-shot confirmation; catastrophic commands are denied.

permissionPreset.dangerConfirmDescription: Ordinary tools and every external MCP will run without approval, and local shell will have no file or network sandbox. Recognized catastrophic commands are still denied, but dynamically generated scripts that cannot be classified may still damage the host; external MCP internals are also outside the local shell guard. Continue only if you explicitly accept these risks.
